## What it is

The ring, the four towers, and the cap, in place, with the tube. Not exported as its own STL.

## Design notes

- 14 hooks on a 965.2 mm tube. 46.94 mm of that is a straight tangent from the outer edge of the ring to the first hook. The helix is the other 918.26 mm, 3.345 turns at 26 mm pitch. One turn along the 43.5 mm centreline is 274.55 mm.
- Number 1 (blue, back-left) has the lowest hook, four in all. Yellow (2, front-left) has four, including the highest. Green (3) has three. Orange (4) has three. The earlier set was 4 + 4 + 4 + 3.
- The tube ends 26.0 mm past the last hook centre, still short of the next tower.
- The four slots are the same. The recessed 1–4 say which tower goes where.

```toml
[part]
min_wall = 1.0
```

## Don't

- Don't mix these towers with the earlier side-printed towers. Those are a hook too tall, and their bores sit 5 mm off this helix.

## Changelog

- 2026-11-25: integrated hooks, straight entry taken out of the turn count, helix drawn through the bore centres.
